hits.name: le_max_left
hits.type: {α : Type u_1} [LinearOrder α] (a b : α) : a ≤ max a b

hits.name: Set.IciExtend_apply
hits.type: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [LinearOrder α] {a : α} (f : ↑(Set.Ici a) → β) (x : α) : Set.IciExtend f x = f ⟨max a x, ⋯⟩

hits.name: Set.IccExtend_apply
hits.type: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [LinearOrder α] {a b : α} (h : a ≤ b) (f : ↑(Set.Icc a b) → β) (x : α) : Set.IccExtend h f x = f ⟨max a (min b x), ⋯⟩
